home.title: DevBoard
home.intro_p1: This project has no fixed goal. The idea is to build as I study — each new thing I learn, I test in here. The result is a growing set of experiments: independent features that coexist and evolve over time.
home.intro_p2: It started as a task manager. It's becoming whatever the learning process requires.

philosophy.label: Project philosophy:
philosophy.text: build first, refine later. If an idea seems relevant to implement, it goes in here — the project grows organically, guided by learning.
